hero.tag: AP — Frontend Engineer · Creative Coder · AI Explorer
hero.desc: Hey. I'm Angie Plazas, a transdisciplinary Fullstack Developer operating at the intersection of generative art, creative coding, mathematics, and modern web engineering. I explore digital aesthetics the way one studies a living organism — with curiosity, with code, and with a bit of chaos.

about.title: 01 // Background
about.heading: Closing the gap between rigid logic and organic expression.
about.p1: My path into development didn't start with the tech boom or the desire to build standard apps. It started long ago, with a genuine interest in how simple computational rules can generate infinitely complex and beautiful patterns.
about.p2: As a creative coder, I work with JavaScript, P5.js, WebGL, Three.js, and React, alongside raw mathematical algorithms and scientific material from my lab and surroundings, to build interactive experiences that blur the line between utility and art. I think of myself as an explorer of complexity: I take difficult systems and make them creative. I'm gradually integrating agents and generative AI into this approach. My approach is clean in structure, but alive in visuals — because what interests me isn't minimalism for its own sake, but the kind of clarity that lets complexity breathe.
